name: Birth Certificate
issuing_office: Registrar of Births and Deaths of the municipal corporation, municipality or Gram Panchayat
department: Health and Family Welfare Department / local registration authority
fee: Kolkata: first certificate issued within one year of birth ₹0; additional copy ₹100; non-availability certificate ₹500.
processing_time: Kolkata private-hospital cases are ordinarily available within about four weeks after registration.
online_process: Register through the hospital or local Registrar; search, apply and download through Janma-Mrityu Tathya where enabled. https://janma-mrityutathya.wb.gov.in/
offline_process: Local Registrar of Births and Deaths, Jurisdictional municipal corporation, municipality or Gram Panchayat office
required_documents: Citizen application: parent address proof selected from Aadhaar, EPIC or Khadya Sathi and hospital discharge certificate; registering authority also uses prescribed Form 1 and event details.
eligibility: Parent, guardian, occupier, hospital or other legally responsible informant reporting a birth in West Bengal.
verification_notes: The statewide prerequisite document supplies the current evidence categories. KMC's current page supports the Kolkata-specific fee and indicative timeline; local-body handling outside Kolkata can differ.

name: Death Certificate
issuing_office: Registrar of Births and Deaths of the municipal corporation, municipality or Gram Panchayat
department: Health and Family Welfare Department / local registration authority
fee: Kolkata: first two copies issued through a KMC crematorium or burial ground ₹0; each additional copy ₹100.
processing_time: On the spot when disposal occurs at a KMC crematorium or burial ground; other cases are processed by the jurisdictional borough or Registrar.
online_process: Register through the institution or local Registrar; search and obtain the certificate through Janma-Mrityu Tathya or KMC. https://www.kmcgov.in/KMCPortal/jsp/KMCBirthDeathHome.jsp
offline_process: Local Registrar of Births and Deaths / KMC borough health office, Jurisdictional municipal corporation, municipality or Gram Panchayat office
required_documents: Address proof of the deceased, father, mother or spouse from Aadhaar, EPIC or Khadya Sathi plus attending-doctor death certificate or discharge certificate; KMC cases outside its cremation system also require institutional or physician proof and the original cremation certificate.
eligibility: Relative, occupier, hospital, crematorium or other legally responsible informant reporting a death in West Bengal.
verification_notes: KMC publishes a distinct crematorium and burial-ground issuance route. The statewide prerequisite document supports the current evidence categories.

name: Marriage Certificate
issuing_office: Marriage Officer appointed under the applicable marriage law
department: Judicial Department, Government of West Bengal
processing_time: Hindu Marriage objections remain open for 7 days and registration must be completed within 6 months; the certificate is issued within 3 days after completion. Special Marriage notice routes ordinarily require 30 days before solemnization or registration.
online_process: Create an online application, select the Marriage Officer and complete the statutory appearance, notice, objection and registration steps for the selected Act. https://rgmwb.gov.in/MARREG_PublicInfo/MARREG_Instructions.aspx
offline_process: Jurisdictional Marriage Officer, Office selected in the West Bengal marriage-registration portal
required_documents: Hindu Marriage route: Schedule A in triplicate, seven joint photographs, age and address proof of both spouses and three witnesses. Special Marriage routes additionally use the statutory notice, declarations and witness particulars.
eligibility: Eligible couples registering an already solemnized Hindu marriage or using the notice and solemnization route under the Special Marriage Act.
verification_notes: The portal separately supports Hindu Marriage Act and Special Marriage Act pathways. A single current consolidated fee schedule covering all pathways was not exposed in the checked instructions, so the fee cell is blank.

name: Legal Heir / Succession Certificate
issuing_office: Collector of Kolkata for the documented route
department: Land and Land Reforms and Refugee Relief and Rehabilitation Department / district administration
online_process: Submit two sets in person to the General Section of the Kolkata Collectorate. https://kolkatacollectorate.wb.gov.in/legal-heir-certificate/
offline_process: General Section, Kolkata Collectorate, Room 101, 1st Floor, North Wing, 11 Netaji Subhas Road, Kolkata 700001
required_documents: Original and copy of affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper before a First Class Magistrate or Notary; councillor certificate; residential proof of all heirs; death certificate; departmental or public-authority requirement letter; two complete sets.
eligibility: Legal heirs of a deceased person residing within KMC limits when a government, semi-government or public-sector authority requires the certificate.
verification_notes: The official Collectorate page documents a complete but deliberately narrow Kolkata route. It is not evidence of an unrestricted statewide legal-heir certificate, and the page does not publish a fee or delivery timeline.

name: Aadhaar Card
issuing_office: UIDAI through Aadhaar Seva Kendra or authorised enrolment centre
fee: Enrolment ₹0; biometric update ₹125; separate demographic update ₹75; document update at a centre ₹75; colour Aadhaar print ₹40. Online document update on myAadhaar is free until 14 June 2027.
online_process: Visit an Aadhaar centre; selected updates and document update are available through myAadhaar. https://appointments.uidai.gov.in/bookappointment.aspx
offline_process: Aadhaar Seva Kendra / authorised enrolment centre, Use the UIDAI centre locator for West Bengal
required_documents: Original Proof of Identity, Proof of Address, Proof of Relationship and Date of Birth documents applicable to the request; Aadhaar number for updates.
eligibility: A resident of India for enrolment; an Aadhaar holder for demographic, biometric or document update.
verification_notes: UIDAI's current service page publishes the national fee schedule and the online document-update waiver date.

name: PAN Card
issuing_office: Income Tax Department
fee: ₹0 for Instant e-PAN.
processing_time: Generally instant after successful Aadhaar verification
online_process: Submit an Instant e-PAN request on the Income Tax e-Filing portal. https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/help/all-topics/e-filing-services/instant-e-pan/instant-UM?mobile-app=1
required_documents: Aadhaar number and access to the Aadhaar-linked mobile number for OTP and e-KYC.
eligibility: An individual with no existing PAN, a valid Aadhaar and Aadhaar-linked mobile, who is an adult and is not a representative assessee, can use Instant e-PAN.
verification_notes: This row documents the free Instant e-PAN route. Physical PAN application channels have separate charges.

name: Voter ID / EPIC
issuing_office: Electoral Registration Officer
department: Election Commission of India / Chief Electoral Officer, West Bengal
online_process: Submit Form 6 online or through the Electoral Registration Officer or Booth Level Officer. https://voters.eci.gov.in/home/forms
offline_process: Electoral Registration Officer / Booth Level Officer, Jurisdictional assembly constituency in West Bengal
required_documents: Recent photograph; proof of date of birth; proof of ordinary residence; Aadhaar if voluntarily provided or the prescribed declaration.
eligibility: An Indian citizen aged 18 years or more on a qualifying date and ordinarily resident in the constituency.
verification_notes: Current ECI Form 6 and its official guidelines support the eligibility and proof categories. The fee cell is blank under the brief's restriction on nationally reusable fees.

name: Passport
issuing_office: Regional Passport Office, Kolkata / Passport Seva Kendras
fee: From 1 July 2026: adult 36-page passport ₹2,500; adult 60-page passport ₹3,500; minor 36-page passport ₹1,750; Tatkaal additional fee ₹2,500.
processing_time: Pre-police-verification cases: 3 working days after a clear police report. Post-police-verification or no-police-verification cases: dispatch by the third working day. Tatkaal: generally 1 or 3 working days, subject to the case.
online_process: Apply and pay online, then attend the scheduled PSK or POPSK appointment. https://www.passportindia.gov.in/AppOnlineProject/user/RegistrationBaseAction?request_locale=en
offline_process: Regional Passport Office, Kolkata / PSK / POPSK, 4 Brabourne Road, Kolkata 700001 (RPO Kolkata); appointment location as selected
required_documents: Application receipt or ARN; proof of present address; proof of date of birth; identity and citizenship evidence; old passport for reissue; category-specific annexures. Originals are shown at PSK or POPSK.
eligibility: Indian citizens applying for a fresh passport, reissue or eligible related service.
verification_notes: The fee schedule effective 1 July 2026 is used. Processing depends on the police-verification mode and completeness of the application.

name: Caste Certificate
issuing_office: Sub-Divisional Officer or District Welfare Officer / competent certificate authority
online_process: Apply online and complete local verification through the competent subdivision or district authority. https://castcertificatewb.gov.in/applicationnew
offline_process: Sub-Divisional Office / District Welfare Office, Jurisdictional subdivision or district in West Bengal
required_documents: Photograph; at least one identity record from EPIC, Aadhaar or Khadya Sathi; evidence of caste, age, citizenship and residence; relative's certificate where available; local referees. OBC applications also require family economic details.
eligibility: West Bengal residents seeking Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe or Other Backward Class certification under the applicable category rules.
verification_notes: The official application guide supplies the shared SC, ST and OBC evidence categories and states that no application fee is charged.

name: Income Certificate
issuing_office: Collector of Kolkata for the documented route
online_process: Submit two complete sets in person to the General Section of the Kolkata Collectorate. https://kolkatacollectorate.wb.gov.in/income-certificate/
offline_process: General Section, Kolkata Collectorate, Room 101, 1st Floor, North Wing, 11 Netaji Subhas Road, Kolkata 700001
required_documents: Affidavit; original income certificate from councillor, MLA or MP; Aadhaar, PAN or EPIC; student and educational records where applicable; ITR when the applicant is a taxpayer; bank details; two sets.
eligibility: Residents within Kolkata requiring an income certificate for education, scholarship or another accepted official purpose.
verification_notes: The official page and current form provide a complete Kolkata checklist. A single equivalent statewide checklist, fee and timeline were not exposed through the current e-District landing page.

name: Domicile / Residence Certificate
issuing_office: Collector of Kolkata for the documented route
online_process: Submit two sets in person to the designated room at the Kolkata Collectorate. https://kolkatacollectorate.wb.gov.in/domicile-certificate/
offline_process: Domicile Certificate Section, Kolkata Collectorate, Room 105/106, 1st Floor, 11 Netaji Subhas Road, Kolkata 700001
required_documents: Completed prescribed form and the identity, address, residence-duration and purpose-specific supporting records listed for the selected use; two sets.
eligibility: A resident within Kolkata Police jurisdiction who needs domicile or residence certification for an accepted official purpose.
verification_notes: The current certificate page and the Collectorate directory conflict on whether the room is in the East or West Wing. The room numbers and main building address agree, so the wing is omitted from the address field.

name: EWS Certificate
issuing_office: Sub-Divisional Officer / competent EWS certificate authority
online_process: Apply online, upload the prescribed evidence and complete local verification. https://castcertificatewb.gov.in/application_ews
offline_process: Sub-Divisional Office / competent EWS authority, Jurisdictional subdivision in West Bengal
required_documents: Aadhaar or Khadya Sathi; EPIC or other citizenship proof; family PAN details; birth or education proof; three years of ITR where applicable; income certificate; domicile; land ROR or deed; local general-category certificate; Annexure B declaration.
eligibility: General-category West Bengal residents who satisfy the current family-income and asset criteria for Economically Weaker Sections.
verification_notes: The official EWS guide provides the evidence list and states that no application fee is charged.

name: Ration Card
issuing_office: District Controller, Food and Supplies / Rationing Officer
online_process: Use the department's digital ration-card application forms or submit through the jurisdictional Food and Supplies office. https://food.wb.gov.in/food/pds/application.html
offline_process: District Food and Supplies Office / Rationing Office, Jurisdictional district or rationing area in West Bengal
required_documents: Aadhaar of applicants and family members; existing ration-card details where applicable; address and family particulars; relationship, migration, death or category evidence required by the selected lifecycle form.
eligibility: Eligible households and individual members seeking inclusion, correction, category service, surrender or migration under West Bengal's public distribution system.
verification_notes: The current department material recognises the listed card categories and lifecycle forms. The fee and service time depend on the selected form and are therefore left blank.

name: Senior Citizen Card
issuing_office: Kolkata Police with The Bengal
online_process: Submit the membership form through the local police station or PRONAM coordination route. https://kolkatapolice.gov.in/kpinitiatives/pronam/
offline_process: Local Kolkata Police station / PRONAM coordination office, Kolkata Police jurisdiction
required_documents: Membership form with photograph, date of birth, address and police-station details; mobile and email; medical information; emergency contact and family particulars.
eligibility: A person aged 65 years or more living alone or only with a spouse within Kolkata Police jurisdiction and without another family member residing with them.
verification_notes: PRONAM is the closest current official senior-citizen membership card route, but it is a Kolkata safety and support programme rather than a statewide entitlement card.

name: Old Age / Widow Pension
issuing_office: BDO in rural areas; SDO in municipal areas outside KMC; Commissioner, KMC within Kolkata
department: Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department / Panchayats and Rural Development Department
fee: ₹0; application forms are supplied free of cost.
online_process: Apply through the rural BDO, municipal SDO or KMC route; scheme data is managed through Jai Bangla. https://jaibangla.wb.gov.in/
offline_process: Block Development Office / Sub-Divisional Office / Kolkata Municipal Corporation, Applicant's jurisdictional BDO, SDO or KMC office
required_documents: Prescribed Jai Bangla form; recent photograph; identity, age and residence proof; bank account details; income and category evidence; death certificate of spouse and widow-status evidence for widow pension.
eligibility: Eligible West Bengal residents under the applicable old-age or widow-pension scheme and its age, income, marital-status and exclusion conditions.
verification_notes: The combined row covers more than one pension scheme under Jai Bangla. Eligibility details and benefit amounts differ by scheme, but the application authorities and free-form rule are common.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship
issuing_office: District Welfare Officer / scheme authority
department: Backward Classes Welfare Department / Minority Affairs and Madrasah Education Department
online_process: Register online, submit the application and complete institution and district verification through the applicable scholarship portal. https://oasis.gov.in/
offline_process: Educational institution / District Welfare Office, Applicant's institution and jurisdictional district office
required_documents: Caste or community certificate number; Aadhaar; mobile; course and institution details; previous examination data; income evidence; Aadhaar-seeded bank account and matching identity particulars.
eligibility: Eligible post-matric students belonging to the covered SC, ST, OBC or minority category and enrolled in a recognised institution.
verification_notes: The row combines category-specific scholarship routes. The official portals publish scheme- and academic-year-specific windows, so a single processing time is not entered.

name: MGNREGA Job Card
issuing_office: Gram Panchayat
processing_time: Job card within 15 days after a valid application and verification.
online_process: Apply orally or in writing to the Gram Panchayat; the Panchayat registers the household and issues the card. https://prd.wb.gov.in/services/resources/Notification/684NREGA.pdf
offline_process: Gram Panchayat office, Applicant's Gram Panchayat within the jurisdictional development block
required_documents: Household members' names, ages and address; electoral-roll or ration-card details for verification where available; photographs of adult applicants.
eligibility: An adult member of a rural household willing to perform unskilled manual work.
verification_notes: The rural application route is the Gram Panchayat, not a municipal office. The fee cell is blank under the brief's nationally reusable fee restriction; the official sources support the 15-day job-card process.

name: Ayushman Bharat / State Health Scheme Card
issuing_office: Swasthya Sathi Samiti / authorised enrolment team
fee: ₹0; the beneficiary makes no premium contribution.
processing_time: Card is issued on the day of successful enrolment at the camp or enrolment point.
online_process: Enrol through the authorised Swasthya Sathi camp or help desk and use the portal for status and card services. https://swasthyasathi.gov.in/
offline_process: Swasthya Sathi enrolment camp / district help desk, Applicant's district, municipality or Gram Panchayat enrolment location
required_documents: Mobile number for OTP; family address with Gram Panchayat or ward details; category particulars; Aadhaar and Khadya Sathi details of family members; prescribed enrolment form.
eligibility: West Bengal families covered by the Swasthya Sathi eligibility framework and not excluded by the current government-funded health-coverage rules.
verification_notes: West Bengal's state scheme is documented instead of substituting an Ayushman Bharat card. The official material supports beneficiary-free enrolment and same-day card issue.

name: Disability Certificate / UDID
issuing_office: Notified medical authority / district medical board
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities / Health and Family Welfare Department
processing_time: Within 3 months when the disability can be diagnosed and assessed.
online_process: Apply through the UDID portal and attend medical assessment at the allocated authority. https://swavlambancard.gov.in/pwd/application
offline_process: Notified hospital / district medical authority, Allocated medical authority in West Bengal
required_documents: Proof of identity; recent photograph not older than six months; proof of residence; Aadhaar or Aadhaar-enrolment details; previous disability certificate where one exists; medical records requested by the assessing authority.
eligibility: A person with a disability specified under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities framework; a guardian or registered organisation may act in permitted cases.
verification_notes: The current notified rules support online application, the evidence categories, the three-month issue limit and permanent or time-bound validity.

name: Health Insurance Card
issuing_office: West Bengal Health Scheme authority / Head of Office
online_process: Create or update beneficiary enrolment through the WBHS portal and complete departmental verification. https://healthscheme.wb.gov.in/first_page.aspx
offline_process: Head of Office / WBHS Medical Cell, Beneficiary's controlling office; Finance Department Medical Cell, Kolkata
required_documents: Recent photograph and signature; blood group; Aadhaar; service and family particulars; PPO and pension details for pensioners; Head-of-Office verification where applicable.
eligibility: Serving state-government employees, pensioners and other beneficiary classes admitted under the West Bengal Health Scheme.
verification_notes: This row distinguishes the employee and pensioner WBHS enrolment certificate from the general-population Swasthya Sathi card.

name: Land Record of Rights
issuing_office: Block Land and Land Reforms Officer
department: Land and Land Reforms and Refugee Relief and Rehabilitation Department
online_process: Use Know Your Property for viewing; use ROR Request and Signed ROR services for an official copy where available. https://banglarbhumi.gov.in/BanglarBhumi/KnowYourProperty.action
offline_process: Block Land and Land Reforms Office, Jurisdictional BL&LRO office for the land parcel
required_documents: Banglarbhumi login or contact details and the district, block, mouza, khatian number or plot number needed to identify the record.
eligibility: A landholder or other person seeking the published record for a West Bengal plot or khatian.
verification_notes: Banglarbhumi currently exposes plot information, ROR Request and Signed ROR functions. The exact charge and delivery time depend on the selected signed-copy workflow and are not entered.

name: Mutation
issuing_office: Block Land and Land Reforms Officer
department: Land and Land Reforms and Refugee Relief and Rehabilitation Department
fee: Agricultural land per decimal: rural ₹40, municipal outside KMDA ₹60, KMDA ₹80. Non-agricultural non-commercial: ₹100, ₹150 and ₹200 respectively. Commercial or industrial rates are higher and depend on area and holding size under the official schedule.
online_process: Submit an online mutation application through Banglarbhumi and complete BL&LRO verification. https://banglarbhumi.gov.in/
offline_process: Block Land and Land Reforms Office, Jurisdictional BL&LRO office for the parcel
required_documents: Registered deed, inheritance or warish basis as applicable; applicant identity and contact details; district, block, mouza, plot and khatian particulars; supporting land and payment records requested in the application.
eligibility: A transferee, legal heir or other person seeking correction of the land record after a valid transfer or succession event.
verification_notes: The official mutation-fee circular distinguishes rural, municipal outside KMDA and KMDA rates. Commercial and industrial charges should be calculated from the full schedule rather than a simplified single amount.

name: Encumbrance Certificate
issuing_office: Kolkata Municipal Corporation
online_process: Enter the assessed-premises details in KMC's online Encumbrance Certificate form. https://www.kmcgov.in/KMCPortal/jsp/EncumbranceCertificate.jsp
offline_process: KMC Assessment-Collection Department, Kolkata Municipal Corporation, 5 S. N. Banerjee Road, Kolkata 700013
required_documents: Online inputs: ward, street name, premises number, assessee number, applicant name, address and status; the system displays current property-tax, water, drainage, licence-fee and pending-court-case data.
eligibility: An owner, assessee or authorised person checking the current municipal dues and pending-matter position of a KMC-assessed premises.
verification_notes: This is a current KMC municipal-dues and pending-matters certificate, not a statewide Sub-Registrar title-encumbrance certificate. The West Bengal registration portal separately offers deed-index searches and certified copies.

name: Sale Deed / Property Registration
issuing_office: Additional District Sub-Registrar / District Registrar
department: Directorate of Registration and Stamp Revenue
fee: Conveyance up to ₹1 crore: stamp duty 5% in other or rural areas and 6% in corporation, municipal or notified areas; above ₹1 crore: 6% and 7% respectively. Registration fee 1% of market value, minimum ₹50. Standard user charge ₹300 up to 17 pages plus ₹9 per additional page.
online_process: Generate e-requisition and assessment, pay duty and fees, present the deed with parties and witnesses, complete biometrics and scanning, then obtain the digitally signed registered deed. https://wbregistration.gov.in/how_to_register_a_deed.aspx
offline_process: Jurisdictional Sub-Registrar Office, Registration office selected for the property jurisdiction
required_documents: Assessment slip; executed deed; identity documents; PAN or Form 60 with identity and address proof; payment records; principal deed for supplementary instruments; permission for restricted tribal transfer where applicable.
eligibility: Parties executing a registrable transfer of immovable property in West Bengal.
verification_notes: The current state schedule is used. The final amount depends on market value, location, instrument and any exemption or additional duty.

name: Property Tax
issuing_office: Kolkata Municipal Corporation
online_process: Register or self-assess under Unit Area Assessment, receive demand and pay online, at e-Kolkata centres or KMC collection offices. https://www.kmcgov.in/KMCPortal/jsp/KMCAssessmentHome.jsp
offline_process: KMC Assessment-Collection Department / borough office, Kolkata Municipal Corporation, 5 S. N. Banerjee Road, Kolkata 700013, or jurisdictional borough office
required_documents: Self Assessment Form or online property particulars; assessee and premises details; ownership or occupancy evidence; property use, area and unit-area attributes; latest bill where an assessee number already exists.
eligibility: The owner, lessee, sub-lessee or other person liable for an assessed premises within KMC.
verification_notes: The documented municipal corporation is Kolkata. The tax is calculated from the property assessment rather than treated as a fixed application fee.

name: Rent Agreement Registration
issuing_office: Sub-Registrar
department: Directorate of Registration and Stamp Revenue
fee: Lease stamp duty is the higher of conveyance duty on the property's market value or conveyance duty on three times average annual rent plus premium, advance or security. Registration fee is under Article A(1); standard user charge ₹300 up to 17 pages plus ₹9 per additional page.
online_process: Use e-Nathikaran for assessment and payment, then present the agreement at the jurisdictional registration office. https://wbregistration.gov.in/reg_process_eNathikaran.aspx
offline_process: Jurisdictional Sub-Registrar Office, Registration office having jurisdiction over the premises
required_documents: Executed lease agreement; assessment slip; identity documents of parties and witnesses; PAN or Form 60; address proof; property particulars; duty and fee payment records.
eligibility: Lessor and lessee executing a lease or rent agreement that they choose or are required to register.
verification_notes: West Bengal's official schedule uses a statutory comparison formula, so a flat rent-agreement amount would be inaccurate.

name: RERA Registration
issuing_office: WBRERA
department: West Bengal Real Estate Regulatory Authority
fee: Residential project: ₹10 per sq. m. where land area is up to 1,000 sq. m., ₹20 per sq. m. above 1,000 sq. m. Commercial or other project: ₹50 and ₹100 per sq. m. respectively.
processing_time: 30 days; deemed registration applies if no decision is communicated within the statutory period.
online_process: Submit the complete project registration online through WBRERA services; offline applications are not accepted from 15 December 2025. https://reraservices.wb.gov.in/
offline_process: West Bengal Real Estate Regulatory Authority, Kolkata, West Bengal
required_documents: PAN; audited balance sheet; three years of ITR; GST particulars; parking details; title deed and mutation; encumbrance details; owner consent or development agreement when the promoter is not owner; approvals, plans and statutory declarations.
eligibility: A promoter of a real-estate project that requires registration under section 3 of the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act.
verification_notes: The current rules support the fee and 30-day decision period. The authority's current portal notice requires online filing.

name: Society / Housing NOC
issuing_office: Board of the registered co-operative housing society; Registrar on appeal
processing_time: An appeal may be made to the Registrar within 30 days of refusal or after 60 days without a society decision.
online_process: Seek written consent from the society's board; appeal to the Registrar under the Co-operative Societies Rules when permitted. https://cooperation.wb.gov.in/housing-cooperatives
offline_process: Registered co-operative housing society / Registrar of Co-operative Societies, Society's registered office; jurisdictional Co-operation Directorate office for appeal
required_documents: Transferee's membership application; copy of the bipartite transfer agreement; declaration to submit a certified copy of the registered sale deed; eligibility and genuine-need particulars; clearance of liabilities to the society.
eligibility: A member proposing to transfer a plot, house or apartment in a registered co-operative housing society.
verification_notes: The documented NOC is the society's written consent for a co-operative housing transfer, not a universal municipal housing NOC.

name: New Electricity Connection
issuing_office: West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Limited
fee: Quotation-based service connection charge plus refundable or adjustable security deposit, calculated from applied load and category by WBSEDCL.
processing_time: Premises inspection within 3 days after quotation payment; connection work within 7 days after the applicant completes statutory formalities.
online_process: Apply online through WBSEDCL or Silpasathi, or submit at the Customer Care Centre; pay the generated quotation and complete inspection and safety formalities. https://portal.wbsedcl.in/webdynpro/resources/wbsedcl/newconselfreg/NewConSelfReg
offline_process: WBSEDCL Customer Care Centre / Regional Office, Customer Care Centre or Regional Office serving the premises
required_documents: Passport-size photograph; identity proof such as passport, EPIC, Aadhaar, driving licence or PAN; ownership or legal-occupancy proof such as sale deed, lease or rent deed, local-body tax receipt or other government occupancy record; electrical self-certification or inspector clearance as applicable.
eligibility: An owner or lawful occupier of premises in a WBSEDCL supply area seeking domestic, commercial, industrial or other electricity supply.
verification_notes: The row is explicitly for WBSEDCL. Charges are quotation-based; the security deposit is not represented as a non-refundable fee.

name: New Water / Sewerage Connection
issuing_office: Kolkata Municipal Corporation
department: Water Supply Department / Chief Engineer's Department, Kolkata Municipal Corporation
fee: 2026-27 domestic water ferrule: 10 mm ₹1,600; 15 mm ₹2,200; 20 mm ₹4,700; 25 mm ₹6,300, plus road-opening and restoration charges. House drainage to 2 m depth: ₹1,247 per m for 150 mm, ₹2,079 for 225 mm or ₹2,948 for 300 mm pipe; manhole or sewer connection ₹208 or ₹519 by diameter.
processing_time: Water route: inspection about 3 days, demand notice about 3 days after inspection and sanction certificate about 1 day after payment.
online_process: Water application through the local KMC Water Supply Section and registered plumber; drainage application through KMC's online new-drainage-connection service and engineering section. https://www.kmcgov.in/KMCPortal/jsp/WaterConnectionSanction.jsp
offline_process: KMC Water Supply Section / Drainage and Sewerage office, Jurisdictional KMC section or borough office; central office at 5 S. N. Banerjee Road, Kolkata 700013
required_documents: Water: prescribed Annex F, copy of sanctioned building plan, building-sanction fee receipt, Assessment-Collection NOC and plumber's Niyog Patra. Drainage: premises and sanctioned drainage or building particulars plus the licensed-plumber work and measurements required by the engineering section.
eligibility: An owner or occupier of premises in KMC seeking a new water ferrule connection and, where required, a house-drainage connection.
verification_notes: The combined row joins two KMC departments. Water documents and timeline are published in the Water Supply FAQ; sewerage charges are current, but an equally explicit current sewerage document checklist is not published on the fee schedule.

name: Building Plan Approval and Completion Certificate
issuing_office: Kolkata Municipal Corporation
fee: 2026-27 one-time plan application fee for land up to 500 sq. m.: residential, educational or institutional use ₹2,000 up to 7 m height, ₹5,000 above 7 to 10 m, ₹11,000 above 10 to 12.5 m, with higher bands thereafter; other uses pay the corresponding higher schedule. Permit and completion charges vary by area, access, use and work.
online_process: Submit plans through the KMC online building-plan system with registered technical professionals; apply for completion certification after compliant construction. https://www.kmcgov.in/KMCPortal/jsp/KMCPortalBuildingHome.jsp
offline_process: KMC Building Department / jurisdictional borough, Kolkata Municipal Corporation, 5 S. N. Banerjee Road, Kolkata 700013
required_documents: Online application and drawings; ownership and assessment records; paid property-tax bill; sanctioned or proposal plans; architect, LBS and structural professional certificates; land-ceiling clearance and fire, environment, airport or other NOCs where triggered; completion drawings and compliance certificates for completion.
eligibility: An owner or authorised applicant proposing building work in KMC and later seeking full or partial completion certification.
verification_notes: The row combines initial plan sanction and later completion certification. The current fee schedule is detailed, but the exact total and completion-stage timeline depend on the proposal and triggered clearances.

name: Driving Licence
issuing_office: Public Vehicles Department in Kolkata / Regional Transport Authority elsewhere
processing_time: Permanent-licence test can be taken after holding the learner's licence for at least 30 days.
online_process: Apply and pay through Sarathi, complete the learner test, then book and pass the driving-competence test at the selected authority. https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/sarathiservice/stateSelection.do
offline_process: PVD Kolkata / jurisdictional RTO or ARTO, Transport office selected for the applicant's residence jurisdiction
required_documents: Form 1 or medical declaration as applicable; application; age and address proof; photographs where required; learner's licence for the permanent test; category-specific training or medical documents.
eligibility: A resident meeting the age and vehicle-class conditions: generally 16 for a gearless motorcycle with guardian consent, 18 for non-transport motor vehicles and 20 for transport vehicles.
verification_notes: The West Bengal authority structure and process are documented from the state FAQ. The fee cell is blank because the current exact table available on Parivahan is national rather than a West Bengal fee notification permitted by the brief.

name: Vehicle Registration Certificate
issuing_office: Public Vehicles Department in Kolkata / Registering Authority elsewhere
processing_time: Apply for permanent registration within 7 days of vehicle delivery, excluding journey time.
online_process: Dealer or owner submits through Vahan and completes inspection, tax and registration formalities at the registering authority. https://vahan.parivahan.gov.in/vahanservice/vahan/ui/statevalidation/homepage.xhtml
offline_process: PVD Kolkata / jurisdictional RTO or ARTO, Registering authority having jurisdiction over the owner's address
required_documents: New registration: Form 20, sale certificate Form 21, road-worthiness certificate Form 22, insurance, address proof, temporary registration where issued, PAN or Form 60 and category-specific certificates. Transfer and duplicate routes require the prescribed RC, NOC, police or loss and transfer forms as applicable.
eligibility: The owner of a new vehicle or a registered owner seeking transfer, duplicate or another registration service.
verification_notes: The state FAQ confirms registration, tax and document requirements. The exact registration table is national while West Bengal road tax, HSRP and smart-card amounts vary, so the fee cell is blank under the brief's fee-source rule.

name: GST Registration
issuing_office: Jurisdictional Central or State GST officer
department: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs / Directorate of Commercial Taxes, West Bengal
processing_time: Normally 7 working days where Aadhaar authentication succeeds and no action is required; up to 30 calendar days where Aadhaar authentication is not completed or fails and no earlier action is taken.
online_process: Submit Form GST REG-01 on the GST portal, complete Aadhaar authentication or physical verification and respond to any clarification notice. https://www.gst.gov.in/
offline_process: Jurisdictional GST office / GST Suvidha Kendra when directed, Determined by the principal place of business in West Bengal
required_documents: PAN; proof of constitution; photographs of proprietor, partners, directors or authorised persons; authorised-signatory proof; principal and additional place-of-business proof; bank details; Aadhaar authentication or GST Suvidha Kendra verification as applicable.
eligibility: A person liable or eligible to register under GST based on turnover, interstate or specified supplies, business form or voluntary-registration rules.
verification_notes: The current GST checklist and Aadhaar-authentication FAQ support the document categories and the two processing tracks.

name: Shops and Establishment Registration
issuing_office: Registering Authority under the West Bengal Shops and Establishments Act
fee: Registration or renewal: shops with 0 employees ₹25, 1–5 ₹30, 6–20 ₹40, above 20 ₹100; establishments with 0 employees ₹25, 1–5 ₹30, 6–20 ₹50, above 20 ₹250.
processing_time: Real time through the current single-window service.
online_process: Apply through Silpasathi, complete the service form, upload evidence and pay the employee-count-based fee. https://silpasathi.wb.gov.in/eodb-services-list
offline_process: Jurisdictional Labour Department office, Labour office mapped to the establishment location
required_documents: Online establishment and employer particulars; address and occupancy proof; constitution and authorised-person details; employee count; trade licence or Certificate of Enlistment and prescribed declarations or forms applicable to the establishment.
eligibility: An employer or occupier of a shop or commercial establishment covered by the West Bengal Shops and Establishments Act, 1963.
verification_notes: The current Silpasathi service manual, fee schedule and delivery-timeline page support the route, employee-count fees and real-time classification.

name: Trade Licence
issuing_office: Kolkata Municipal Corporation
fee: Variable by nature of trade, premises area and applicable KMC Act sections under the 2026-27 Licence Department schedule.
processing_time: Integrated single-window route is classified as real time; legacy KMC guidance describes up to 7 days for some cases.
online_process: Apply online for a new KMC Certificate of Enlistment or use the integrated Silpasathi route where available; pay the generated demand. https://www.kmcgov.in/KMCPortal/jsp/TradeLicenceShop.jsp
offline_process: KMC Licence Department / unit office, KMC central or jurisdictional Licence Unit Office in Kolkata
required_documents: Application and self-declaration; occupancy proof; government photo identity; partnership, company, LLP or society constitution records as applicable; authorised-person proof; trade-specific statutory permissions.
eligibility: A person carrying on a profession, trade or calling within KMC jurisdiction.
verification_notes: The 2026-27 fee schedule is current. KMC and the integrated single-window materials describe different timing conventions, so the route-specific timing is retained instead of selecting one silently.

name: Udyam / MSME Registration
issuing_office: Ministry of MSME
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
processing_time: Certificate is generated online after successful submission and validation.
online_process: Register only on the official Udyam portal using Aadhaar authentication and applicable PAN or GST data. https://udyamregistration.gov.in/UdyamRegistration.aspx
offline_process: District Industries Centre for facilitation, Jurisdictional District Industries Centre in West Bengal
required_documents: Aadhaar of proprietor, managing partner or authorised person; PAN and GSTIN as applicable. The portal retrieves linked tax data and does not require document uploads for normal registration.
eligibility: A proprietorship, partnership, company, LLP, co-operative, trust or other eligible enterprise meeting the current MSME investment and turnover criteria.
verification_notes: The national official portal states zero cost and warns against unauthorised private sites. The Government Fee cell remains blank because the brief permits nationally reusable fees only for its specified services.

name: FSSAI Registration / Licence
issuing_office: Designated Officer / Central Licensing Authority
department: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India / Health and Family Welfare Department
processing_time: Registration decision or inspection route follows the statutory 7-day and 30-day steps; licence service timelines can extend to 60 days depending on type and inspection.
online_process: Use the FoSCoS eligibility tool, submit the appropriate registration or licence application, upload documents, pay and complete inspection where required. https://foscos.fssai.gov.in/search-eligibility/CL
offline_process: Designated Food Safety Officer / licensing authority, Authority allocated by FoSCoS for the West Bengal premises
required_documents: Form B where licensing applies; proprietor, partner or director identity and list; premises possession proof; layout and machinery details for manufacturing; food categories; water analysis, NOCs and activity-specific documents where triggered.
eligibility: Every food business operator; registration or licence type depends on the current nature, scale, capacity and turnover criteria in FoSCoS.
verification_notes: The combined row covers registration, State licence and Central licence. Exact documents, fee and time are generated by the current eligibility result; the national FoSCoS fee is not copied into the state workbook under the brief's fee restriction.

name: Professional Tax PTRC/PTEC
issuing_office: Professional Tax Officer
processing_time: Registration is listed as real time on Silpasathi.
online_process: Use the West Bengal Professional Tax online system or the applicable Silpasathi service for registration or enrolment. https://egov.wbcomtax.gov.in/PT_Enrollment/
offline_process: Jurisdictional Professional Tax Office, Commercial Taxes jurisdiction for the establishment or profession
required_documents: PAN; legal constitution and authorised-person particulars; establishment or professional address; contact details; nature of business or profession; employee and bank particulars relevant to registration or enrolment.
eligibility: An employer liable to deduct professional tax requires registration; a person, professional or business liable in their own right requires enrolment.
verification_notes: Registration and enrolment are separate liabilities. Silpasathi lists registration as available while its service page has described enrolment reintegration, so applicants should use the currently active portal link for their route.

name: Fire NOC
issuing_office: Director General, West Bengal Fire and Emergency Services / authorised officer
processing_time: 60 days for the Fire Safety Certificate service.
online_process: Apply online, upload the comprehensive checklist, undergo inspection and remedy observations before certificate issue. https://wbfes.gov.in/Issuance_of_Fire_Safety_Certificate
offline_process: West Bengal Fire and Emergency Services / local fire station, Authority allocated to the premises location
required_documents: Identity proof; area statement; completion certificate; sanctioned plan; last Fire Safety Recommendation where applicable; electrical-wiring report; site, floor, key, section, roof and structural plans; deed; PAN; power of attorney; drill or compliance evidence as applicable.
eligibility: An owner, occupier, developer or authorised applicant whose residential, commercial, industrial or institutional premises requires a Fire Safety Certificate.
verification_notes: The row documents the Fire Safety Certificate used as the operational Fire NOC. Fire Safety Recommendation is a related but separate pre-construction service with its own fee basis.

name: Liquor Licence
issuing_office: Collector of Excise / Excise Commissioner according to licence class
fee: Variable by licence class, location and local-body category under the official West Bengal Excise local-sale fee schedule.
online_process: Choose the licence class in the Excise online application, upload documents, pay the generated fees and complete enquiry, site inspection and approval. https://excise.wb.gov.in/Public_License_Application/Public_License_Application.aspx
offline_process: District Excise Office / Collector of Excise, Jurisdictional excise district for the premises
required_documents: Photograph; nationality proof such as EPIC, passport or PAN; date-of-birth proof; education and medical-fitness records where required; non-conviction affidavit; food or FSSAI licence for applicable premises; ownership, occupancy, site-plan and class-specific documents.
eligibility: An eligible individual, firm or company seeking the selected manufacture, wholesale, retail, bar, hotel or other excise licence and satisfying premises and character conditions.
verification_notes: The active portal covers many licence classes with materially different fees and approval chains. The fee cell therefore points to the official variable schedule rather than giving one misleading amount.

name: EPFO / UAN
issuing_office: EPFO
fee: ₹0 for UAN allotment and activation.
processing_time: UAN is generated or activated after successful Aadhaar face authentication and validation.
online_process: Use UMANG with Aadhaar Face Authentication for allotment and activation; use the EPFO member portal for linked services. https://unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in/memberinterface/
offline_process: EPFO regional or district office, EPFO office serving the establishment in West Bengal
required_documents: Aadhaar; Aadhaar-linked mobile; smartphone with UMANG and Aadhaar Face RD applications; facial authentication. Employment and KYC details are linked for member services.
eligibility: An employee who is or becomes an EPF member; the employer links employment, while eligible members can allot and activate UAN through the current UMANG route.
verification_notes: The current circular discontinued direct portal allotment and activation in favour of UMANG Aadhaar Face Authentication.

name: ESI Card
issuing_office: ESIC through the covered employer
processing_time: Insurance number and e-Pehchan are generated after the employer completes employee registration.
online_process: Employer registers the employee in the ESIC portal; the insured person downloads or receives e-Pehchan and completes identity updates as needed. https://www.esic.gov.in/insured-person-employer-login
offline_process: ESIC branch office / dispensary, Branch office or dispensary allocated to the insured person's area in West Bengal
required_documents: Employee and family identity particulars; residential address; dispensary choice; family photograph; nominee and relationship details; employer registration and insurance-number data; Aadhaar seeding where voluntarily completed.
eligibility: An employee in insurable employment at a covered establishment, together with eligible family members.
verification_notes: The e-Pehchan card is generated through employer registration; employee and employer contributions are insurance contributions, not a card-issuance fee.

name: Labour Card (BOCW)
issuing_office: West Bengal Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board / Labour Welfare Facilitation Centre
fee: ₹0 under Bina Mulya Samajik Suraksha Yojana; the state bears the beneficiary contribution.
online_process: Register through the BMSSY portal or obtain assistance at the Regional Labour Office or Labour Welfare Facilitation Centre. https://bmssy.wblabour.gov.in/
offline_process: Regional Labour Office / Labour Welfare Facilitation Centre, Jurisdictional block or municipal facilitation centre
required_documents: Aadhaar; EPIC; Khadya Sathi; mobile; residential address with block, municipality, Gram Panchayat or ward; occupation and worker type; bank account; nominee and family particulars.
eligibility: A West Bengal resident aged 18–60 working as a building or other construction worker and satisfying BMSSY worker conditions.
verification_notes: Construction-worker registration has moved to BMSSY rather than the legacy e-District route. The current scheme page supports the no-cost treatment.

name: Bank Account KYC
issuing_office: Regulated bank or financial institution
department: Reserve Bank of India / regulated bank
online_process: Complete KYC at a branch, through permitted digital KYC or video customer identification, or through an authorised business correspondent for eligible updates.
offline_process: Customer's bank branch / authorised business correspondent, Selected bank branch in West Bengal
required_documents: PAN or Form 60; one officially valid document such as passport, driving licence, Aadhaar possession proof, EPIC, NREGA job card or NPR letter; photograph and additional financial or business information required by the bank's risk policy.
eligibility: An individual opening, operating or periodically updating an account with a regulated bank.
verification_notes: The RBI Master Direction and current amendment support the officially valid document categories and permitted KYC channels. Bank-specific onboarding controls can add requirements.

name: Income Tax Return
issuing_office: Central Board of Direct Taxes / Income Tax Department
processing_time: Return due date varies by assessment year and taxpayer category; e-verification is generally required within 30 days of filing.
online_process: Select the correct ITR form, prepare and submit through the e-Filing portal, then e-verify within the allowed period. https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/help/all-topics/e-filing-services/file-income-tax-return
offline_process: Jurisdictional Income Tax office for assisted or notice proceedings, Jurisdiction determined by PAN and taxpayer profile
required_documents: PAN and Aadhaar-linked access; Form 16 or 16A; AIS and TIS; bank and interest information; business, capital-gain, house-property and deduction records applicable to the chosen ITR form. Returns are annexure-less, but evidence should be retained.
eligibility: A person required or eligible to file an income-tax return for the relevant assessment year under the applicable income, entity and filing rules.
verification_notes: A single row cannot represent every ITR form and assessment-year due date. The common filing and verification process is documented, while form-specific schedules remain taxpayer-dependent.

name: GST Returns (GSTR-1 / GSTR-3B)
issuing_office: Jurisdictional Central or State GST officer
department: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs / Directorate of Commercial Taxes, West Bengal
processing_time: Standard GSTR-1 due dates are the 11th of the following month for monthly filers and the 13th after the quarter for quarterly filers. GSTR-3B is generally due on the 20th monthly; West Bengal QRMP filers generally use the 24th after the quarter, subject to notification extensions.
online_process: Prepare, validate and file GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B through the GST portal, then discharge the net liability through the electronic ledgers. https://www.gst.gov.in/
offline_process: Jurisdictional GST office, Determined by GST registration jurisdiction in West Bengal
required_documents: Outward invoices and credit or debit notes; inward-supply and ITC data from GSTR-2B or IMS; tax-liability, electronic-credit and cash-ledger information; amendments and reverse-charge records.
eligibility: A regular GST-registered taxpayer required to furnish outward-supply details in GSTR-1 and liability and input-tax-credit summary in GSTR-3B; special taxpayer categories use different returns.
verification_notes: The standard calendar is stated with an explicit notification-extension caveat. Composition and special-category taxpayers do not use this exact pair in the same way.

name: Eating House Licence
issuing_office: Administrative Officer, Kolkata Police
department: Home and Hill Affairs Department / Kolkata Police
processing_time: 30 days after submission of a complete new police-licence application; renewal service 10 days.
online_process: Submit the prescribed police-licence application and establishment evidence to the Kolkata Police Licence Section. https://kolkatapolice.gov.in/contact/
offline_process: Licence Section, Kolkata Police, 18 Lalbazar Street, Kolkata 700001
eligibility: A proprietor or operator seeking the police licence required for an eating house, restaurant, hotel, boarding or lodging establishment within Kolkata Police jurisdiction.
verification_notes: The Home Department RTPS notification provides the responsible officer and timelines. The current Kolkata Police public pages do not expose a complete licence-class document checklist or fee schedule, so those cells remain blank.

name: Police Verification for Hotel Guests
issuing_office: Registration Officer / FRRO or FRO; local police for lawful inspection
department: Ministry of Home Affairs / Bureau of Immigration / West Bengal Police
processing_time: Transmit Form III within 24 hours after the foreigner's arrival and departure; retain the electronic accommodation record for at least one year.
online_process: Register the accommodation provider and submit Form III electronically through the Bureau of Immigration portal; maintain guest records for inspection. https://indianfrro.gov.in/frro/FormC/accom_reg.jsp
offline_process: FRRO Kolkata / district FRO or Registration Officer, Registration authority serving the accommodation location in West Bengal
required_documents: Accommodation-provider registration details; foreign guest photograph, full passport name, nationality, passport number, visa or OCI number and type, Indian contact and email, arrival source, date and time, purpose and previous stay; departure time and next destination. Ordinary guest registers should retain identity and contact particulars under police safety guidance.
eligibility: Every keeper of hotel, guest house, hostel, homestay, rented accommodation or similar premises accommodating a foreigner, including an OCI cardholder.
verification_notes: The current legal process is guest reporting and record maintenance, not a pre-arrival police-clearance certificate for each guest. The 2025 Rules include OCI cardholders and replace former Form C with Form III.

name: Notarized Affidavit
issuing_office: Registered Notary Public
department: Department of Legal Affairs / Directorate of Registration and Stamp Revenue
fee: West Bengal affidavit stamp duty ₹10 unless a statutory exemption applies; the notary's service charge is separate.
processing_time: Usually completed during the notarial appearance after identity and document checks.
online_process: Prepare the affidavit on the applicable stamp, appear before a registered notary, establish identity, swear or affirm and sign in the notary's presence. https://notary.gov.in/act-and-rules
offline_process: Office of a registered Notary Public, Within the notary's authorised area of practice in West Bengal
required_documents: Purpose-specific affidavit text; original government photo identity; address and factual supporting records; appropriate West Bengal non-judicial stamp or lawful stamp-duty payment; personal appearance and signature before the notary.
eligibility: A person making a sworn or affirmed written statement for a lawful purpose.
verification_notes: West Bengal's current stamp-duty page lists ₹10 for an affidavit; court-use and other statutory exemptions may apply. The national notarial charge ceiling is not copied into the fee cell under the brief's fee restriction, and drafting charges are separate.
